_comment: Always-on rule injection (default on). A cheap shell guard runs the injector unless always_on_injection is explicitly false — defaulting on at the code level so a fresh install activates even if Claude Code does not export unset-but-defaulted userConfig values to the hook env. Set the option false to opt out; then rules load on demand as skills and this guard costs only a shell test (no python3 cold-start). SessionEnd/PreCompact run memory-backup.py the same way, gated on enable_memory (default on) and a non-empty memory_path — no separate store configured means native memory is already canonical, nothing to mirror.

hooks.command: sh -c 'v="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ALWAYS_ON_INJECTION:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_always_on_injection:-}}"; v=$(printf %s "$v" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]"); case "$v" in false|0|no|off) ;; *) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.py" ;; esac'

sh -c 'mp="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_MEMORY_PATH:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_memory_path:-}}"; em="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ENABLE_MEMORY:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_enable_memory:-}}"; em=$(printf %s "$em" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]"); case "$em" in false|0|no|off) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -z "$mp" ] && exit 0; exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-backup.py"'

sh -c 'mp="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_MEMORY_PATH:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_memory_path:-}}"; em="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ENABLE_MEMORY:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_enable_memory:-}}"; em=$(printf %s "$em" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]"); case "$em" in false|0|no|off) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -z "$mp" ] && exit 0; exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-backup.py"'
